name: Social-Media-AI-Agent
headline: Social-Media-AI-Agent - Automate Instagram
short_description: Social-Media-AI-Agent is an AI-powered automation tool designed for Instagram to automate social media interactions such as posting, liking, and commenting. It uses advanced AI models to generate engaging content, automate interactions, and manage Instagram accounts efficiently.
author: harshmriduhash

sections.overview:
Social-Media-AI-Agent is an automation tool that streamlines Instagram account management by automating key interactions: posting photos, liking posts, and leaving comments. The tool uses Google Generative AI to create engaging captions and comments, reducing manual content creation time. It supports proxy management for handling multiple accounts and cookie management to maintain persistent sessions. Before automation, users can train the agent with personal content sources including YouTube videos, audio files, portfolios, and documents (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT) to generate personalized interactions. The skill benefits social media managers, content creators, and marketers seeking to scale engagement without manual effort.
Automate daily Instagram posting and engagement across multiple accounts
Generate AI-powered captions and comments tailored to account tone
Manage Instagram sessions with persistent cookie storage
Scale account management using proxy support for multiple profiles
